LESSON: BELIEF IN QADAR

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: GRADE
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Belief in Qadar
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Belief in Qadar, part of Pillars of Iman in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: Why should Muslims believe in Qadar and Qadha?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
